title: QC
description: For testers: compare screenshots, shrink recordings to a size limit, stamp timecodes, copy bug-report details.

actions.label: Image diff
actions.description: Compare two images: changed pixels in red, plus the % that differ
actions.command: open "flickwheel://tool?name=diff&$(printf '%s\n' "$INPUTS" | perl -ne 'chomp; $p = join q(), map { /[A-Za-z0-9_.~-]/ ? $_ : sprintf(q(%%%02X), ord) } split //; print q(path=), $p, q(&)')"

actions.label: To MB
actions.description: Re-encode to fit a size limit (asks for MB), e.g. 10 MB for Jira or Slack
actions.command: r=$(osascript -e 'text returned of (display dialog "Target size in MB" default answer "10" buttons {"Cancel","Go"} default button "Go" with title "FlickWheel")') || { echo Cancelled >&2; exit 1; }; r=${r// /}; [[ $r =~ ^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$ ]] && (( r >= 1 )) || { echo 'Use a number of MB, 1 or more' >&2; exit 1; }; dur=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$INPUT"); kbps=$(awk -v mb=$r -v d=$dur 'BEGIN{ k=int(mb*8192*0.93/d) - 128; print (k<100?100:k) }'); ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i "$INPUT" -vf "scale='trunc(iw/2)*2':'trunc(ih/2)*2'" -c:v libx264 -b:v ${kbps}k -maxrate ${kbps}k -bufsize $((kbps*2))k -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart "$(fw_out "$DIR/$NAME-${r}mb.mp4")"

actions.label: Timecode
actions.description: Burn a running timecode into the video so a bug can be pinpointed

actions.label: Report
actions.description: Copy name, size, type, dimensions or duration and SHA-256 for a bug report
actions.command: f="$INPUT"; { echo "File: ${f:t}"; echo "Size: $(stat -f%z "$f") bytes ($(du -sh "$f" | cut -f1))"; echo "Type: $(file -b --mime-type "$f")"; case "${f:e:l}" in png|jpg|jpeg|heic|tiff|bmp|gif|webp) sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight "$f" | awk '/pixelWidth/{w=$2} /pixelHeight/{h=$2} END{print "Dimensions: " w "x" h}';; mp4|mov|m4v|mkv|webm|avi|mp3|wav|m4a|flac|ogg) ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration:stream=codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate -of default=nw=1 "$f" | sed 's/^/  /';; esac; [ -f "$f" ] && echo "SHA-256: $(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; echo "Modified: $(stat -f%Sm -t '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' "$f")"; echo "Path: $f"; } | pbcopy

actions.label: Errors
actions.description: Copy the last 200 lines that mention an error, fatal, exception, fail or panic
actions.command: out=$(grep -n -i -E 'error|fatal|exception|fail|panic' "$INPUT" | tail -200); [[ -n $out ]] || { echo 'No error lines found' >&2; exit 1; }; print -r -- "$out" | pbcopy
